G: the finite group in the theorem
Z(G): the center of G, consisting of elements that commute with every element of G
C_G(x): the centralizer of x in G, equal to {g in G: gx=xg}
\\operatorname{Cl}_G(x): the conjugacy class of x in G
[G:C_G(x)]: the index of C_G(x) in G, namely the number of its left cosets
Cl_G(x): the conjugacy class of x in G, equal to {gxg^{-1}: g in G}
Phi_x: the map from left cosets of C_G(x) to the conjugacy class of x
K_i: the i-th conjugacy class of G having more than one element
r: the number of noncentral conjugacy classes of G
n: the integer at least 1 such that the order of G is p^n
K_x: the conjugacy class of x under the conjugation action of G
c: an element of the centralizer C_G(x)
a: a nonnegative integer exponent such that the conjugacy-class size is p^a
K: a noncentral conjugacy class occurring in the class-equation sum
[G:H]: the number of left cosets of a subgroup H in G
x_i: a representative of the i-th noncentral conjugacy class
